name: ViDoSeek
description: ViDoSeek is a novel dataset designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) performance on visually rich documents that require complex reasoning, integrating both textual and visual features.
reputation: A newer multimodal RAG benchmark that is gaining attention for testing reasoning over visually rich documents, but it is not yet as established as long-running benchmarks.
notes: Designed to benchmark RAG methods on dense visual documents; highlights limitations of existing methods and supports multi-agent iterative reasoning.
